snippet.title: SHOCK Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
SHOCK Gameplay Trailer
A glimpse into the nightmare of SHOCK!

Enter the world of SHOCK, a third-person survival horror experience where you play as "Jack" a disabled war veteran stalked by a relentless cybernetic creature. This cinematic teaser sets the tone for the horrors to come.
Demo coming soon during Steam October Next fest! 

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391130/SHOCK/
